cues: Opens with an 'About this plan' note that checks the workspace (README says empty) and states that nothing was inspected, so assumptions are tagged [A#] and collected in one table
Fixed, numbered section skeleton: ranked quality attributes, Current State, Assumptions/Open Questions, Key Decisions, Cross-Cutting Concerns, Build Sequence, Deferred Work, Next Steps

First-milestone task breakdown with 'Done when' criteria and spikes carrying 'Changes plan if' conditions; closes with the questions that would change the plan most
